units.function: Sequential embedded-PostgreSQL HTTP scenario verifying Chinese, Japanese and Hindi Issue content survives create/read/search/comment/document/completion/list and heartbeat-context flows.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises real Issue routes, database and membership authorization with a cloud-tenant board actor; storage is stubbed and no translation/localization service participates.
units.keyDataModels: Company and active user membership; Issue title/description/status; comment body/order; Markdown document body; completion comment; heartbeat context and comment cursor.
units.lifecycle: Create multilingual Issue; read and search it; add multilingual comment/document; complete with multilingual note; list ordered comments; project original content into execution context.
units.testAssessment: Eight integration cases cover a useful full content path and a non-admin cloud-member actor, but all skipped locally because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. The stateful sequential structure can cascade failures. Missing are normalization/digest semantics, complex Unicode classes, byte limits, search-tokenizer depth, malformed encodings, injection/redaction, tenant denial and Agent data-scope tests.
units.designRationale: Ensure international user and Agent content is preserved as data rather than corrupted, translated or dropped by storage, search or execution-context assembly.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS targets Chinese enterprises while supporting international teams; user input, Agent output, evidence and logs must preserve original language independently from future switchable Chinese/English UI localization.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT this end-to-end preservation slice into isolated and scenario tests. Store original UTF-8 content unchanged; define canonical serialization for signatures/digests without silently rewriting displayed text; record contentType/language only as optional metadata; build a separate normalized search projection with Chinese-capable tokenization; test NFC/NFD, emoji, combining marks, RTL, control/bidi spoofing, byte limits and export/import. Keep stable error/event codes language-neutral and authorize every heartbeat/evidence projection by the Agent's DataGrant.
units.responsibilityConflict: No direct conflict: preserving original evidence is required for responsibility. However, projecting full multilingual text into heartbeat context without an Agent-specific data contract could leak content, and any hidden Unicode normalization between approval and execution could break digest-bound responsibility evidence.
